wake_2.text: *Kay slaps the alarm off without opening his eyes.*

wake_4.speaker: Kay
wake_4.text: If I stayed home, would anyone even notice?

wake_5.text: *He reaches for the phone beside his pillow. One unread message in the group chat.*

wake_6.speaker: Bank
wake_6.text: kay did u finish the slides?? 😭

wake_7.text: *Sent at 1:48 AM. Kay finished them at 2:30. His part, and theirs.*

wake_8.speaker: Kay
wake_8.text: The presentation's first period. It's fine. I practiced.

wake_9.speaker: Kay
wake_9.text: ...I practiced their parts too. Just in case.

bfast_1.text: *The kitchen is quiet. Mom already left for work.*

bfast_2.text: *There's a sticky note on the fridge: "Eat something real today! - Mom"*

nap_3.speaker: Kay
nap_3.text: —! I'm late. I'm late, I'm late.

shower_1.text: *He turns on the shower and waits for it to get warm.*

shower_3.speaker: Kay
shower_3.text: I'll tell Mom later. She has enough to deal with.

shower_4.text: *He showers fast, shivering, then pulls on his uniform.*

gate_1.text: *The school gate. Same as every morning.*

gate_2.speaker: Kay
gate_2.text: That's Elysia... with her friends again.

gate_3.speaker: Kay
gate_3.text: She looks busy. I won't bother her.

gate_4.text: *Before he can look away, Elysia turns around like she felt him there. She smiles and waves.*

gate_5.text: *Kay waves back. A little too late, a little too stiff.*

gate_6.text: *One of her friends tugs her arm. She mouths "later!" and gets pulled back into the group.*

gate_12.speaker: Ulyn
gate_12.text: "You did their slides again, didn't you."

gate_14.speaker: Kay
gate_14.text: "They were busy. It was faster if I just did it."

gate_16.text: *Ulyn doesn't push. He gives Kay a long look, then starts walking.*

gate_17.speaker: Ulyn
gate_17.text: "Come on, leader. Don't be late to your own presentation."

pres_2.text: *Group 3 is up first: Kay, Ulyn, and the two classmates Kay has now done three projects with. They stand at the front of the room, a careful gap between each of them.*

pres_3.speaker: Kay
pres_3.text: "Good morning. We're group 3, and today we're presenting the life of Barack Obama."

pres_4.text: *His voice comes out steady. His smile is the one he practiced in the mirror. His eyes keep moving around the room, landing on nothing.*

pres_5.speaker: Kay
pres_5.text: "I'm Kay, the group leader. I'll start us off, then hand over to—"

pres_6.speaker: Ulyn
pres_6.text: "Ulyn. I made the slides, so if they look good, you're welcome."

pres_7.text: *A few people laugh. Ulyn clicks to the next slide.*

pres_8.speaker: Bank
pres_8.text: "Uh... hi. I did the, um, the research part."

pres_9.text: *He looks down at his phone. Scrolls. Scrolls again.*

pres_10.speaker: Bank
pres_10.text: "So Obama was... he was born in..."

pres_11.text: *Silence. Somebody's chair squeaks. The teacher's pen stops moving.*

pres_12.speaker: Kay
pres_12.text: He doesn't know it. He never read it.

choices.text: Step in and cover for him

pres_wait_1.text: *Kay waits. Two seconds. Five. Someone in the back whispers something and giggles.*

pres_wait_2.text: *The teacher looks over. Not at Bank. At Kay.*

pres_cover.speaker: Kay
pres_cover.text: "—Hawaii, 1961. Sorry, I'll jump in, we split this part."

pres_13.text: *Kay keeps going. He knows every date. He wrote every line.*

pres_14.text: *Bank nods along like they planned it.*

pres_15.speaker: Fern
pres_15.text: "And I did the design! So, um, this slide is about..."

pres_16.text: *She points at a slide she has clearly never seen before.*

pres_17.text: *Kay steps forward again and explains it smoothly, like it was always meant to be his.*

pres_18.speaker: Teacher
pres_18.text: "Very well organized, group 3. Good teamwork, everyone."

pres_22.text: *Ulyn doesn't say anything. He's looking at Kay, not at them.*

after_1.text: *Back at their seats, Ulyn drops into the chair next to him.*

after_2.speaker: Ulyn
after_2.text: "Why didn't you just let him blank?"

after_3.speaker: Kay
after_3.text: "In front of everyone? That would've been mean."

after_4.speaker: Ulyn
after_4.text: "It would've been fair. You wrote his part. You wrote her part. And they get the same grade as you."

after_5.speaker: Ulyn
after_5.text: "Last semester it was the science poster. Before that, the English skit."

choices.text: "They just forgot. It's not a big deal."
"...I didn't want to make it awkward for anyone."

after_forgot.speaker: Ulyn
after_forgot.text: "Right. They forgot. For the third time."

after_8.text: *Ulyn sighs and turns to face the front. He doesn't sound angry anymore. Just tired.*

after_10.speaker: Kay
after_10.text: Should I have told the teacher? No. Then they'd get in trouble, and it would be my fault.

lunch_2.speaker: Ulyn
lunch_2.text: "Hey, so... I can't eat with you today. My chemistry report's due tomorrow and I haven't started."

lunch_4.speaker: Ulyn
lunch_4.text: "You sure? I can put it off and just do it tonight."

lunch_5.text: *He would, too. Kay knows he would.*

lunch_ask_1.speaker: Kay
lunch_ask_1.text: If he stays, he'll be up all night finishing it.

lunch_ask_2.speaker: Kay
lunch_ask_2.text: Because I didn't want to eat alone. Like a little kid.

lunch_fine_1.speaker: Kay
lunch_fine_1.text: "I'm good. Really. Don't worry about me."

lunch_fine_2.speaker: Ulyn
lunch_fine_2.text: "...Okay. Save me a seat in class, then."

lunch_fine_3.text: *Ulyn jogs off toward the building. Kay watches him go for a little longer than he needs to.*

lunch_fine_4.speaker: Kay
lunch_fine_4.text: He has his own stuff. I'm not going to be the reason he fails a report.

lunch_stay_2.text: *Ulyn blinks. Then he grins and drops his bag onto the seat.*

lunch_stay_3.speaker: Ulyn
lunch_stay_3.text: "Took you long enough. Do you know how long I've been waiting for you to ask me for something?"

lunch_stay_4.speaker: Kay
lunch_stay_4.text: "We've been friends for, like, two years."

lunch_stay_6.text: *They get fried rice and argue about nothing. Ulyn complains about chemistry the whole time.*

lunch_stay_8.speaker: Ulyn
lunch_stay_8.text: "Kay. Shut up and eat your rice."

lunch_stay_9.text: *For twenty minutes, Kay doesn't think about the presentation at all.*

food_kp_1.speaker: Kay
food_kp_1.text: Pad kra pao. Please don't be out of crispy pork.

food_kp_4.text: *He turns around. Elysia, hands behind her back, smiling like she's been waiting.*

food_kp_5.speaker: Elysia
food_kp_5.text: "Pad kra pao again? You're so predictable."

food_kp_6.speaker: Kay
food_kp_6.text: "Y-you're one to talk. You're in the same line."

food_kp_7.speaker: Elysia
food_kp_7.text: "Mm. And why do you think I'm in this line?"

food_kp_good2.text: *She rolls her eyes, but she's still smiling.*

food_kp_9.speaker: Elysia
food_kp_9.text: "You know, I always have to come find you. You never come find me."

food_kp_10.speaker: Kay
food_kp_10.text: "I didn't want to bother you. You're always with your friends."

food_kp_12.speaker: Lunch Lady
food_kp_12.text: "Are you two ordering, or just flirting?"

food_kp_15.speaker: Elysia
food_kp_15.text: "Come sit with us if you want, okay?"

food_kp_16.text: *She takes her tray back to her friends' table, glancing over her shoulder once.*

food_nd_1.speaker: Kay
food_nd_1.text: Noodles. The line's long, but whatever.

food_nd_2.text: *He joins the end of the queue.*

food_nd_3.text: *Two familiar voices drift back from a few people ahead.*

food_nd_4.speaker: Bank
food_nd_4.text: "Dude, I totally blanked up there. Good thing Kay knew everything."

food_nd_5.speaker: Fern
food_nd_5.text: "Kay always knows everything. That's why I always want him in my group."

food_nd_6.speaker: Bank
food_nd_6.text: "Literally. I didn't even open the slides until this morning."

food_nd_7.speaker: Fern
food_nd_7.text: "Same, haha. He doesn't mind, though. He offered."

food_nd_10.text: *They laugh. Not mean. Just easy, like it's nothing.*

food_nd_11.speaker: Kay
food_nd_11.text: They're not wrong. I did offer.

food_nd_say_2.text: *They turn around. Their faces light up.*

food_nd_say_3.speaker: Bank
food_nd_say_3.text: "Kay! We were just talking about you. Next project, we're with you again, cool?"

food_nd_say_4.text: *Kay opens his mouth. Everything he was going to say is gone.*

food_nd_quiet_1.text: *Kay looks down at his phone and pretends he didn't hear anything.*

food_nd_quiet_2.text: *A minute later, the group chat buzzes: "next proj w kay again?? 🙏" "ofc"*

food_nd_quiet_3.text: *He types "sure!" and sends it before he can think about it.*

food_nd_end.text: *When it's his turn, he orders beef noodles. He doesn't really taste them.*

food_fr_3.text: *The line moves fast. Nobody talks to him. That's fine.*

food_fr_5.speaker: Bank
food_fr_5.text: thx for today kay ur a lifesaver 🙏

food_fr_6.speaker: Kay
food_fr_6.text: ...They're thanking me. That's good. That's nice.

food_fr_7.text: *He types "np!" and puts his phone away.*

seat_1.text: *Kay stands with his tray, looking for a seat.*

seat_2.text: *Elysia's table is by the window. She's laughing at something one of her friends said.*

seat_el_1.speaker: Kay
seat_el_1.text: She's with her friends. Would it be weird if I just showed up?

seat_el_yes.speaker: Kay
seat_el_yes.text: ...She did say to come sit with her.

seat_el_2.speaker: Kay
seat_el_2.text: "Hey. Is it okay if I sit here?"

seat_el_4.text: *Her friends go quiet and look at him. Then at her. Then at him again. They obviously know exactly who he is.*

seat_el_5.speaker: Elysia
seat_el_5.text: "Hey. Stop staring at him. Eat your food."

seat_el_6.text: *Her cheeks are pink. She's pouting, but not because she's upset.*

seat_el_7.text: *Under the table, she bumps his foot with hers. Just once.*

seat_el_8.speaker: Kay
seat_el_8.text: She's louder around her friends. ...It's kind of cute.

seat_alone_1.text: *Kay finds an empty table near the back and eats alone.*

seat_alone_3.text: *From here, he can hear Elysia laughing across the room.*

class2_2.text: *Kay and Ulyn sit next to each other, like always.*

class2_el_2.speaker: Ulyn
class2_el_2.text: "Ohh? You saw Elysia, didn't you. Look at your face."

class2_stay.speaker: Ulyn
class2_stay.text: "My report's going to be terrible, by the way. Worth it."

class2_hec_1.speaker: Teacher
class2_hec_1.text: "Alright, home economics. Today we're talking about plants."

class2_hec_2.text: *The teacher goes on about soil and sunlight. Kay only half listens.*

class2_hec_3.speaker: Teacher
class2_hec_3.text: "The most common way people kill a plant isn't forgetting about it. It's overwatering it. Giving it more than it can take."

class2_hec_4.text: *Kay thinks about the plants in his front yard. He waters them every single day.*

walk_2.text: *Kay is halfway through the gate when he hears his name.*

walk_4.text: *Behind her, a couple of her friends are watching. One whispers something to the other.*

walk_5.speaker: Kay
walk_5.text: If people see us together, they'll talk about her. Because of me.

walk_no_1.speaker: Kay
walk_no_1.text: "I... shouldn't. You don't want people looking at us like that."

walk_no_2.text: *For half a second, something in her face drops.*

walk_no_5.text: *She smiles, waves, and walks off alone. Her smile stays on a beat too long.*

walk_yes_3.text: *She grabs his hand and pulls him along before he can change his mind.*

walk_yes_4.speaker: Elysia
walk_yes_4.text: "My friends keep teasing me about you, you know."

walk_yes_5.speaker: Kay
walk_yes_5.text: "Sorry. I didn't mean to make things weird for you."

walk_yes_6.speaker: Elysia
walk_yes_6.text: "Why are you sorry? I don't care what they think."

walk_yes_10.text: *She laughs, but she holds his hand a little tighter.*

walk_yes_11.text: *Her house isn't far. Somehow the walk still feels too short.*

home_1.text: *He walks the rest of the way home alone.*

home_2.text: *In his room, Kay falls face-first onto his bed, still in his uniform.*

home_rum_2.speaker: Kay
home_rum_2.text: She said it was fine. She smiled.

home_rum_3.speaker: Kay
home_rum_3.text: ...I say it's fine too. All the time.

home_rum_4.speaker: Kay
home_rum_4.text: I should text her. And say what? "Sorry I didn't want to be seen with you"?

home_rum_5.text: *He opens their chat. Types. Deletes it. Types again. Deletes that too.*

home_rum_6.speaker: Kay
home_rum_6.text: I'll leave it. I'd just make it worse.

plants_1.text: *Kay goes out to the front yard and turns on the hose.*

plants_2.text: *The water is loud enough that he doesn't have to think.*

plants_3.text: *A car pulls into the driveway. Mom's home from work.*

plants_4.speaker: Mom
plants_4.text: "Look at you, doing chores without being asked."

plants_6.speaker: Mom
plants_6.text: "Did you eat breakfast? I know the fridge is empty. Sorry. I'll go shopping this weekend."

choices.text: "We had the presentation. I kind of did everyone's part."

plants_told_2.speaker: Mom
plants_told_2.text: "You know you don't have to carry everybody, right?"

plants_10.text: *She squeezes his shoulder and heads inside. She looks tired. He doesn't mention the water heater.*

plants_12.text: *The soil has been dark and soaked for a while now. He keeps watering anyway.*

plants_13.text: *Eventually he goes back to his room and checks the time.*

phone_2.text: *Cat videos. A cat falls off a table. A cat is scared of a cucumber. Another cat. Another one.*

phone_3.text: *He doesn't laugh, but he doesn't stop scrolling either.*

phone_4.text: *Two hours disappear. He only notices when his phone gets hot.*

phone_ulyn_1.text: *A notification slides down over the video. It's Ulyn.*

phone_ulyn_2.speaker: Ulyn
phone_ulyn_2.text: yo. you good? you seemed off today

phone_ulyn_4.speaker: Kay
phone_ulyn_4.text: Don't make him worry. He already spent the morning being annoyed at me.

choices.text: "actually... today was kind of a lot"

phone_ulyn_no_1.speaker: Ulyn
phone_ulyn_no_1.text: ok. i'm here if you wanna talk. like whenever

phone_ulyn_no_3.text: *Kay puts his phone face-down and stares at the ceiling until it gets dark.*

phone_ulyn_yes_1.text: *He stares at what he typed for a long time. Then he hits send before he can delete it.*

phone_ulyn_yes_3.speaker: Ulyn
phone_ulyn_yes_3.text: lunch tmr? just us. my treat

phone_ulyn_yes_5.text: *It doesn't fix anything. But his chest feels a little less tight.*

hw_1.text: *Kay pulls his chemistry book out of his bag.*

hw_3.text: *He puts his headphones on and starts writing.*

hw_4.text: *He finishes the worksheet. Then he starts on tomorrow's, too.*

hw_5.text: *Then he opens the group chat and looks at the topic list for next month's project.*

hw_6.speaker: Kay
hw_6.text: Might as well get a head start.

hw_6_over.speaker: Kay
hw_6_over.text: They'll want me to do it anyway.

hw_7.text: *He starts outlining. His part, and theirs. It's easier than sitting with his thoughts.*

hw_8.text: *When he finally looks up, his neck hurts. He checks the time.*

night_3.text: *He grabs his pajamas and turns on the shower.*

night_5.text: *He showers fast, climbs into bed, and turns off the light.*

night_6.text: *He can't sleep. Pieces of the day keep coming back.*

night_12.text: *He stares at the dark ceiling for a long time.*

night_open_2.speaker: Kay
night_open_2.text: ...Maybe tomorrow will be a little better.

tue_wake_2.text: *Kay wakes up at 6:10, before the alarm. He lies still and lets the ceiling get lighter.*

tue_wake_3.text: *He checks the group chat out of habit. Nothing new. A sticker from Bank at midnight. A meme Fern forwarded from somewhere.*

tue_open_1.text: *The first thing he sees when he unlocks his phone is last night's chat.*

tue_open_2.speaker: Ulyn
tue_open_2.text: lunch tmr? just us. my treat

tue_open_5.speaker: Kay
tue_open_5.text: I said it. I actually said it.

tue_open_6.text: *He waits for the embarrassment to arrive. It does, a little. Something else comes with it, something quieter, and he doesn't have a name for it yet.*

tue_el_2.speaker: Elysia
tue_el_2.text: morning K!! walking home together again today?? 👀

tue_elw_yes_1.text: *She sends six hearts in a row, then unsends five of them.*

tue_elw_yes_2.text: *Kay laughs out loud, alone in his room. It surprises him.*

tue_elw_no_2.text: *He doesn't have to stay late. He just remembers her friends watching yesterday. The one who whispered.*

tue_elr_1.speaker: Elysia
tue_elr_1.text: goooood morning!! ☀️ did u eat breakfast

tue_elr_2.text: *Like yesterday never happened. Kay knows that trick. He does it too.*

choices.text: "sorry about yesterday. i didn't mean it like that."

tue_elr_sorry_1.text: *The typing dots appear. Disappear. Appear again.*

tue_elr_sorry_5.speaker: Elysia
tue_elr_sorry_5.text: but thank u for saying sorry 🫶

tue_elr_sorry_6.speaker: Kay
tue_elr_sorry_6.text: It stung. She said it stung.

tue_elr_sorry_7.text: *Elysia never says things like that. She trusted him with it. He holds the phone a little longer than he needs to.*

tue_elr_fine_2.text: *She sends a sticker of a furious cat. Everything looks normal.*

tue_shower_1.text: *The shower is still cold. He washes fast.*

tue_shower_2.speaker: Kay
tue_shower_2.text: It wakes me up better anyway.

tue_shower_3.text: *On the fridge there's a new sticky note under the old one: "Sorry about the fridge!! Weekend, promise. - Mom"*

proj_1.text: *Homeroom. The teacher writes COMMUNITY PROJECT on the board and underlines it twice.*

proj_2.speaker: Teacher
proj_2.text: "Groups of four. Find something in our school community that isn't working, and fix it."

proj_3.speaker: Teacher
proj_3.text: "Not a poster. Not slides. Fix it. In the last week of the semester, you present what you did."

proj_5.text: *Before Kay can turn around, Bank is already dragging his chair across the floor. Fern is right behind him.*

proj_7.speaker: Ulyn
proj_7.text: "He's with me. You two can come, I guess."

proj_8.text: *So it's group 3 again. Same four. Same careful gaps.*

proj_9.speaker: Bank
proj_9.text: "Can we do the vending machine? It eats coins. That's a community problem."

proj_10.speaker: Fern
proj_10.text: "Kay, you pick. You always pick good stuff."

proj_11.text: *Kay opens his mouth, but Ulyn is already pointing out the window, past the science building, at four raised wooden beds gone wild with weeds.*

proj_12.speaker: Ulyn
proj_12.text: "The garden. The agriculture club died two years ago. Nobody's touched it since."

proj_13.speaker: Teacher
proj_13.text: "...Approved. That's actually a good one, group 3."

proj_14.speaker: Fern
proj_14.text: "Ooh. Aesthetic. I can do before-and-after photos."

proj_17.text: *Fern turns to Kay with her pen already uncapped.*

proj_18.speaker: Fern
proj_18.text: "So you'll do the report and the plan, right? You're so good at that."

choices.text: "Let's split it. Everyone writes up the part they work on."

proj_sure_2.text: *Beside him, Ulyn's pen stops moving. He doesn't say anything.*

proj_split_1.text: *A small pause. Kay braces for it.*

proj_split_3.speaker: Fern
proj_split_3.text: "Okay! Then I'll do the photos and the design part."

proj_split_5.text: *He had three arguments ready. He didn't need any of them.*

proj_split_6.text: *Under the desk, Ulyn taps Kay's shoe with his own. Just once.*

tlunch_2.text: *Ulyn drops into the seat across from him.*

tlunch_3.text: *Then he puts his forehead on the table.*

tlunch_4.speaker: Ulyn
tlunch_4.text: "Finished the chemistry report at three. Don't look at me."

tlunch_5.text: *Kay knows exactly what three in the morning feels like. Neither of them says so.*

tlunch_open_1.text: *Ulyn buys two plates of pad kra pao, crispy pork, a fried egg on each, and slides one across the table without a word.*

tlunch_open_2.speaker: Kay
tlunch_open_2.text: He's going to ask. What "a lot" meant. What happened.

tlunch_open_3.text: *The questions don't come. Ulyn eats and complains about the sports day budget.*

tlunch_open_5.speaker: Ulyn
tlunch_open_5.text: "You said yesterday was a lot. I believe you. You don't have to give me a report on it."

tlunch_open_7.speaker: Ulyn
tlunch_open_7.text: "I mean, you can. Whenever. I'm just not going to make you present it."

tlunch_open_8.speaker: Kay
tlunch_open_8.text: "Was that a joke about the presentation?"

tlunch_open_10.text: *It's the first lunch in a long time where Kay doesn't have to be anything.*

tlunch_stay_1.text: *He slaps his chemistry report on the table. A big red C- at the top.*

tlunch_stay_4.speaker: Ulyn
tlunch_stay_4.text: "Say sorry one more time and I'm telling everyone you asked me to stay because you missed me."

tlunch_stay_6.text: *Ulyn goes completely quiet. Then he grins, way too wide, and doesn't stop for the rest of lunch.*

kettle_1.text: *That night, Kay boils the kettle and carries it to the bathroom, mixing it with cold water in a bucket so he can wash his hair without his scalp going numb.*

kettle_2.text: *Mom gets home in the middle of it. She stops in the bathroom doorway, still in her hospital shoes.*

kettle_3.speaker: Mom
kettle_3.text: "What are you doing with the kettle?"

choices.text: "The water heater's broken. It's been broken for a week."

kettle_told_1.speaker: Mom
kettle_told_1.text: "A week? Kay. Why didn't you say anything?"

kettle_told_3.text: *Mom puts her bag down right there on the hallway floor.*

kettle_told_4.speaker: Mom
kettle_told_4.text: "I'm not too busy for you to have hot water."

kettle_told_5.text: *She calls the repair shop that second and waits on hold for twenty minutes, tapping her foot. They can come Thursday.*

kettle_told_6.text: *It's a small thing. Somehow, it doesn't feel small.*

kettle_tea_3.text: *She laughs, too tired to ask anything else. He drinks a cup of tea he doesn't want, and later he washes his hair in cold water.*

tnight_1.text: *In bed, Kay stares at the ceiling.*

tnight_3.speaker: Kay
tnight_3.text: At least I know how to do this. It's the one thing I always know how to do.

tnight_split_1.speaker: Kay
tnight_split_1.text: They said yes. Just like that.

tnight_split_2.text: *He keeps turning it over, looking for the catch.*

garden_1.text: *Saturday. The garden behind the science building: four raised beds, weeds up to the knee, a hose with three holes in it, and a tap that screams when you turn it.*

garden_2.text: *The group agreed on 8 a.m. Kay gets there at 7:40.*

garden_3.text: *Ulyn shows up at 8:20 with a bag of bread and no apology. Fern arrives at nine and takes before-photos for twenty minutes.*

garden_split_1.text: *But Fern actually stays an extra hour. She pulls weeds and complains about her nails the whole time. She pulls them, though.*

garden_split_2.text: *And Bank turns up at ten anyway, red-faced, holding four cold drinks like an apology.*

garden_noi_1.text: *At noon, Ms. Noi, the home economics teacher, comes by. She agreed to be their advisor. She brings a paper bag of seeds and a trowel she says is older than all of them.*

garden_noi_2.speaker: Ms. Noi
garden_noi_2.text: "Water spinach. Basil. Chili. Marigolds around the edges, to keep the bugs off."

garden_noi_3.speaker: Ms. Noi
garden_noi_3.text: "Water spinach is forgiving. Basil isn't. Chili sulks if you love it too much."

garden_noi_6.speaker: Ms. Noi
garden_noi_6.text: "Once a day. In the morning. Only if the soil is dry."

garden_noi_7.speaker: Ms. Noi
garden_noi_7.text: "Push your finger in, like this. If it's damp, leave it alone."

garden_noi_8.text: *Kay writes it down in his notebook, word for word.*

weeks_1.text: *For two weeks, Kay comes to the garden every morning before homeroom and every afternoon after the last bell.*

weeks_2.text: *He pushes his finger into the soil the way she showed him. It's always a little damp.*

weeks_4.speaker: Kay
weeks_4.text: Doing nothing feels wrong. Doing nothing feels like not caring.

weeks_5.text: *Ulyn comes when he can, which isn't often. Sports day is coming, and the student council put him in charge of half of it.*

weeks_6.text: *He's also tutoring on Saturdays, and sleeping at his cousin's place again. Kay knows that last part the way he knows most things about Ulyn now: from the edges, without asking.*

bug_1.text: *One afternoon, Elysia comes to the garden alone. Her friends went to the mall.*

bug_2.text: *She crouches by the chili bed to look at the seedlings, and then goes very still.*

bug_3.speaker: Elysia
bug_3.text: "Oh. Oh! Kay. Come here. Don't move fast."

bug_4.text: *On the old log edging the bed, something bright yellow has spread across the bark. Like spilled egg yolk, branching into veins like a tiny map.*

bug_5.speaker: Elysia
bug_5.text: "That's a slime mold. Physarum, I think. It doesn't even have a brain, and it can still solve a maze. Scientists put oat flakes down like the cities around Tokyo, and it grew the train lines—"

bug_6.speaker: Elysia
bug_6.text: "It's not even lots of cells, it's one giant cell with millions of nuclei, all sharing—"

bug_7.text: *She stops in the middle of the sentence and glances over her shoulder at the path. Then she laughs, too bright.*

bug_8.speaker: Elysia
bug_8.text: "Sorry. That's weird. Nobody cares about slime."

choices.text: "We should probably head back before it gets dark."

bug_care_2.text: *Then she keeps going. Slowly at first, then fast again. Pink slime molds, slime molds that crawl a few centimeters an hour, the one she kept in her lunchbox in third grade that got out of a paper maze overnight.*

bug_care_3.text: *She sounds different. Not the loud cafeteria Elysia. Not the polite-smile Elysia.*

bug_care_4.speaker: Kay
bug_care_4.text: This is what she sounds like when she isn't checking.

bug_care_5.speaker: Kay
bug_care_5.text: I want to be someone she never has to check around.

bug_leave_2.text: *She stands up and brushes off her knees. On the walk out, she talks about the mall trip, a café, a lot of things.*

bug_leave_3.text: *She doesn't mention the slime mold again.*

bug_leave_4.speaker: Kay
bug_leave_4.text: I missed something. I don't know what.

bug_tired_5.text: *He laughs it off. She doesn't laugh.*

mint_1.text: *The next day, a girl stops Kay outside the library. Short. Blunt bob. Doesn't smile.*

mint_5.text: *She doesn't explain. She doesn't need to. Kay knows the name. Eleven years. Since kindergarten.*

mint_6.speaker: Mint
mint_6.text: "She talks about you a lot. Don't make that face, it's a good thing."

mint_8.speaker: Mint
mint_8.text: "She's been tired lately. She won't say it. She'd rather explode than be a bother to anyone."

mint_9.text: *Kay hears it like a sentence about himself.*

mint_10.speaker: Mint
mint_10.text: "Just look out for her. You two are the same kind of idiot."

mint_11.text: *She walks away before he can answer.*

wrecked_1.text: *End of the third week. Ulyn falls asleep in history with his forehead on the student council folder.*

wrecked_5.text: *After the bell, Kay notices Ulyn's eyes are red at the edges. His phone buzzes on the desk: Mom.*

wrecked_6.text: *Ulyn declines it without looking and shoves it in his pocket.*

wrecked_ask_1.text: *Ulyn blinks, like nobody's asked him that in a while.*

wrecked_quiet_5.text: *He doesn't. Ulyn wipes his cheek anyway.*

sprout_1.text: *On the last Friday of the third week, the first seedlings come up. Water spinach first, little green hooks pushing out of the soil.*

sprout_2.text: *Kay takes a picture and sends it to the group chat before he can talk himself out of it.*

sprout_bug_1.text: *He sends it to Elysia too. She replies in four seconds.*

midterm_2.text: *Study until one. Garden at 6:30. Exam. Garden after school. Study until one.*

midterm_4.speaker: Bank
midterm_4.text: kay can u do the research part 😭 i'm dying w midterms

midterm_draft_1.speaker: Bank
midterm_draft_1.text: kay can u look at my part 🙏 i wrote some but its bad

midterm_draft_2.text: *He opens the file. Half a page. Most of it is the title.*

choices.text: "just send me what you have. i'll do it."
"i'll help after exams. but you write it."

midterm_do_2.text: *Kay writes three pages between 11 p.m. and 1:40 a.m., and studies for chemistry in the gaps.*

midterm_teach_3.speaker: Bank
midterm_teach_3.text: can u at least tell me where to start

midterm_teach_5.text: *He sends three bullet points instead of three pages.*

midterm_teach_6.text: *It feels like dropping something he was supposed to be holding. He waits for it to break.*

score_1.text: *Thursday. The history teacher hands back the midterms. Kay is top of the class again.*

score_4.text: *Kay looks at the number for a long time. It's like reading somebody else's score.*

yellow_1.text: *That afternoon, the chili seedlings are yellow.*

yellow_2.text: *The basil leaves hang soft and dark at the edges. The soil smells sour, like a wet towel left in a bag.*

yellow_6.text: *Ms. Noi is standing at the end of the bed. She crouches, pushes her finger into the soil, and pulls it out muddy to the knuckle.*

yellow_7.speaker: Ms. Noi
yellow_7.text: "This is soaked. How often are you watering?"

yellow_9.text: *She sighs. It isn't an angry sigh.*

yellow_10.speaker: Ms. Noi
yellow_10.text: "They're not dying of thirst, Kay. They're drowning. The roots can't breathe."

yellow_12.speaker: Ms. Noi
yellow_12.text: "I know. That's usually how it happens."

yellow_13.text: *She shows him how to loosen the top of the soil and let it dry. The water spinach will be fine. It forgives almost anything. Two of the basil plants are already gone.*

yellow_15.speaker: Kay
yellow_15.text: I did everything right. I did more than right.

mnight_2.speaker: Kay
mnight_2.text: Two dead basil plants. It's just basil.

mnight_3.text: *He thinks about it anyway, for a long time.*

mnight_heavy_1.speaker: Kay
mnight_heavy_1.text: If I stayed home tomorrow, would anyone notice?

mnight_heavy_2.speaker: Kay
mnight_heavy_2.text: The garden would be fine. Better, probably. Without me drowning it.

mnight_heavy_3.speaker: Kay
mnight_heavy_3.text: Everyone would be fine without me.

mnight_heavy_4.text: *The thought just sits there. It doesn't feel dramatic. It feels like the answer to a math problem he worked out a while ago and is only now checking.*

mnight_heavy_5.speaker: Kay
mnight_heavy_5.text: I'm just tired. It's just exams.

mnight_phone.text: *His phone is on the pillow. Ulyn's name is right there at the top of his chats.*

mnight_text_1.text: *He sends it before he can delete it.*

mnight_down_1.text: *He puts the phone face down on the floor, out of reach.*

absent_2.text: *Kay doesn't slap the alarm off. He lets it ring until it gives up on its own.*

absent_3.text: *He knows he has to get up. His body doesn't move.*

absent_4.text: *It isn't like being tired. It's more like the distance between him and the floor got bigger overnight.*

absent_try_1.text: *He sits up. Feet on the floor.*

absent_try_2.text: *His uniform is on the chair, two meters away. It might as well be across the ocean.*

absent_try_3.text: *He sits on the edge of the bed for forty minutes. Then he lies back down.*

absent_mom_3.text: *It sounds completely normal. He's very good at that.*

absent_mom_6.speaker: Ulyn
absent_mom_6.text: where are u. ur never late

absent_late_1.speaker: Ulyn
absent_late_1.text: sorry fell asleep at like 11!! u ok??

absent_msgs_1.speaker: Elysia
absent_msgs_1.text: K? didn't see u at the gate 👀

absent_msgs_3.speaker: Bank
absent_msgs_3.text: kay where's the garden key?? ms noi says we have to check on it today lol

absent_msgs_4.text: *Kay makes a sound that's almost a laugh.*

absent_msgs_7.speaker: Kay
absent_msgs_7.text: If I stayed home, would anyone notice?

absent_msgs_8.speaker: Kay
absent_msgs_8.text: ...Four people. Five, if you count the basil.

absent_msgs_9.text: *He answers Bank first, because it's the easiest.*

absent_msgs_10.speaker: Kay
absent_msgs_10.text: spare key's under the blue pot. don't water if the soil's wet.

absent_msgs_11.text: *He can say that about the plants without any trouble.*

choices.text: Reply to Elysia: "i couldn't get up today"

absent_down_1.text: *He turns it over. It keeps buzzing for a while. Then it stops.*

absent_text_1.text: *Her reply comes before he can regret it.*

absent_text_2.speaker: Elysia
absent_text_2.text: ok. thank u for telling me.

absent_text_3.speaker: Elysia
absent_text_3.text: do u want me to call or do u want me to leave u alone

absent_text_4.speaker: Kay
absent_text_4.text: leave me alone for now. sorry

absent_call_1.text: *Ulyn picks up on the first ring. He's whispering. He's in class.*

absent_call_5.speaker: Ulyn
absent_call_5.text: "Okay. I'm coming after school. Don't argue."

knock_1.text: *Kay sleeps through the afternoon without meaning to.*

knock_2.text: *4:10. Someone knocks on the front door.*

step_1.text: *Ulyn is still in his uniform, holding a plastic bag: two cartons of pink milk, crispy pork from the stall by school, and the cheap coconut cookies Kay used to eat every day in tenth grade.*

step_4.text: *They sit on the front step, because Kay doesn't want Ulyn to see his room.*

step_5.text: *The plants in the front yard, the ones Kay waters every single day, have yellow leaves too.*

step_6.speaker: Ulyn
step_6.text: "Your plants look worse than our garden."

step_9.text: *Ulyn picks at the corner of the cookie packet.*

step_10.speaker: Ulyn
step_10.text: "You weren't at school. You're never not at school."

step_11.speaker: Ulyn
step_11.text: "You came in with a fever in tenth grade. You threw up in the bin by the stairs and then sat through math."

step_called_3.speaker: Ulyn
step_called_3.text: "You've never called me. Not once. Not since—"

step_called_5.speaker: Ulyn
step_called_5.text: "It was the best phone call I ever got, and you said one word."

step_texted_1.speaker: Ulyn
step_texted_1.text: "You texted me last night. 'You up.' And I was asleep. And then you weren't at school, and I thought—"

step_conf_1.speaker: Ulyn
step_conf_1.text: "Can I say something? You don't have to say anything back."

step_conf_3.speaker: Ulyn
step_conf_3.text: "Last year. March. You messaged me at like three in the morning. 'Can I call you.'"

step_conf_4.speaker: Ulyn
step_conf_4.text: "I saw it. And I didn't answer for four days. And then I said, 'sorry, was busy.'"

step_conf_5.text: *Kay remembers the exact words. He's never stopped remembering them.*

step_conf_6.speaker: Ulyn
step_conf_6.text: "My parents were splitting up. That week was the worst one."

step_conf_7.speaker: Ulyn
step_conf_7.text: "My dad moved out. My mom cried in the bathroom every night with the shower running so I wouldn't hear. I was sleeping at my cousin's because I couldn't be in that house."

step_conf_8.text: *His voice is flat, the way people sound when they've practiced saying something in their heads.*

step_conf_9.speaker: Ulyn
step_conf_9.text: "I saw your message and I thought, I don't have anything. If he needs something, I don't have anything to give."

step_conf_10.speaker: Ulyn
step_conf_10.text: "So I didn't answer. And then it was too late to answer properly, so I sent the worst possible thing."

step_conf_12.speaker: Ulyn
step_conf_12.text: "And you never asked me for anything again. Not even 'can I call you.'"

step_conf_13.speaker: Ulyn
step_conf_13.text: "I've been waiting a whole year for you to try again so I could do it right. And you just got really, really good at being fine."

choices.text: "It's fine. It was a long time ago."
"I thought I was too much. That's why I stopped."
"Why didn't you tell me about your parents?"

step_fine_2.speaker: Kay
step_fine_2.text: "Really. You had your own stuff going on."

step_fine2_1.text: *Ulyn looks at him for a long time. Then he nods, slowly.*

step_fine2_3.text: *He doesn't believe it. He stays anyway. They eat the crispy pork in silence until the streetlights come on.*

step_why_2.speaker: Ulyn
step_why_2.text: "Because you'd have done the thing. You'd have taken it on."

step_why_3.speaker: Ulyn
step_why_3.text: "You'd have fixed my whole life at 2:30 in the morning like those slides, and I didn't want to be one more thing you carry."

step_why_5.text: *Ulyn wipes his face with the back of his wrist.*

choices.text: "...I thought I was too much. That's why I stopped asking."

step_quiet_1.text: *They sit. After a while, Ulyn bumps Kay's shoulder with his own.*

step_honest_2.text: *It's harder out loud than it was in his head. It comes out in pieces.*

step_honest_3.speaker: Kay
step_honest_3.text: "When my dad left, I was twelve. Mom cried at the kitchen table for like a month."

step_honest_4.speaker: Kay
step_honest_4.text: "And I decided I'd just be easy. The kid who doesn't need anything."

step_honest_5.speaker: Kay
step_honest_5.text: "And when you didn't answer, I thought, yeah. That's right. That's what happens when I ask."

step_honest_7.speaker: Kay
step_honest_7.text: "And this year it's been... It's like everything's far away. I wake up and I already want the day to be over."

step_honest_8.speaker: Kay
step_honest_8.text: "Some nights I think everyone would be fine without me. Not like— I'm not going to do anything. I just think it. Like it's a fact."

step_honest_9.text: *Ulyn is quiet for a moment. He doesn't look scared. He looks like he's choosing his words very carefully, and Kay is more grateful for that than anything.*

step_honest_10.speaker: Ulyn
step_honest_10.text: "It's not a fact. And thank you for telling me. I mean it."

step_honest_11.speaker: Ulyn
step_honest_11.text: "But I'm not okay with you thinking that alone. Will you talk to someone? Someone who actually knows what to do. Not just me throwing pork at you."

step_honest_12.speaker: Ulyn
step_honest_12.text: "Ms. Noi runs the guidance room on Thursdays. My cousin went to something like that last year. It helped him."

step_honest_13.text: *Kay doesn't answer yet. Ulyn doesn't make him.*

step_honest_14.speaker: Ulyn
step_honest_14.text: "And you're not too much. You were never too much. I was too little, that week. That's different."

step_honest_15.text: *Kay's eyes sting. He cries quietly, the way he learned how to when he was twelve.*

step_honest_16.text: *Ulyn pretends not to look and pushes the second carton of pink milk into his hand.*

step_honest_17.speaker: Ulyn
step_honest_17.text: "I'm not okay either, by the way. I don't go home if I can help it. That's why I'm on every committee in this school."

step_honest_20.speaker: Kay
step_honest_20.text: "You decline your mom's calls in class."

step_honest_22.text: *They both laugh. It's small and tired, but it's real.*

mom_1.text: *Mom gets home at eight. She doesn't take her shoes off.*

mom_2.speaker: Mom
mom_2.text: "The school called. They said you were absent."

mom_3.speaker: Mom
mom_3.text: "You said bye this morning like everything was normal."

mom_heater_1.speaker: Mom
mom_heater_1.text: "You told me about the heater. It got fixed. See? You can tell me things."

mom_easier_1.speaker: Kay
mom_easier_1.text: I already said it once today.

mom_easier_2.speaker: Kay
mom_easier_2.text: It's easier the second time. Not easy. Easier.

choices.text: "I couldn't get up. I haven't been okay for a while."

mom_fine_1.text: *Mom puts her palm on his forehead.*

mom_fine_4.text: *She looks at him a moment too long.*

mom_fine_6.text: *He goes. Later, through the wall, he hears her on the phone with his aunt.*

mom_fine_8.text: *His own words, in somebody else's mouth.*

mom_told_1.text: *Mom sits down slowly at the kitchen table. The same table.*

mom_told_2.text: *Kay braces for her to cry. She doesn't. Not yet.*

mom_told_4.speaker: Kay
mom_told_4.text: "...Since the start of the year. Maybe before."

mom_told_5.text: *She reaches across the table and takes his hand.*

mom_told_6.speaker: Mom
mom_told_6.text: "Kay. When your dad left, you got so easy. You stopped asking for anything. And I was so tired that I let you."

mom_told_7.speaker: Mom
mom_told_7.text: "I thought, he's okay. Thank god one of us is okay."

mom_told_8.speaker: Kay
mom_told_8.text: "I didn't want to make it worse."

mom_told_9.speaker: Mom
mom_told_9.text: "You don't make it worse. You're my kid. You're not a chore I'm managing."

mom_told_10.text: *Then she does cry, a little, and laughs at herself for crying.*

mom_told_12.text: *She says she'll ask the hospital for a weekend off. She asks if there's someone at school he could talk to, or if she should find someone.*

mom_thursday_1.speaker: Kay
mom_thursday_1.text: "Ulyn said there's a teacher. On Thursdays."

mom_heatcheck_1.text: *Mom wipes her eyes with the heel of her hand.*

mom_heatcheck_2.speaker: Mom
mom_heatcheck_2.text: "Also. Why is there a kettle in the bathroom?"

mom_heatcheck_7.text: *She laughs and cries at the same time. So does he.*

sat_1.speaker: Elysia
sat_1.text: tomorrow. 10am. i'm picking u up. no is not an option 😤

sat_3.text: *She takes him to the park by the canal and hands him a can of milk tea.*

sat_4.text: *They sit on a bench facing the water. A monitor lizard swims past very slowly, like it has somewhere to be.*

sat_museum_1.text: *She takes him to the natural history museum across the river. It's free on Saturdays.*

sat_museum_2.text: *She walks straight past the dinosaurs to a dim room of fungi and slime molds, tiny dried specimens in glass cases, labeled in tiny handwriting.*

sat_museum_3.speaker: Elysia
sat_museum_3.text: "I've never brought anyone here. Not even Mint. Mint knows. But I've never brought anyone."

sat_talk_1.text: *Elysia turns her drink around in her hands.*

sat_talk_2.speaker: Elysia
sat_talk_2.text: "Were you sick on Thursday? Bank said you were sick."

sat_early_1.speaker: Elysia
sat_early_1.text: "You told me you couldn't get up. Thank you for telling me. You don't have to explain it."

choices.text: "I want to explain it. Some of it."

sat_tell_1.text: *So he tells her. Not everything, but enough. The mornings. The weight. How everything feels far away. The front step.*

sat_tell_2.text: *Then the part he's never said out loud.*

sat_tell_3.speaker: Kay
sat_tell_3.text: "At school I keep away from you because I think being seen with me makes people talk about you. Makes you look weird."

sat_tell_5.speaker: Elysia
sat_tell_5.text: "You think you make me look weird?"

sat_hold_2.text: *She pulls her knees up onto the bench.*

sat_hold_3.speaker: Elysia
sat_hold_3.text: "Can I tell you something, then? Since you're not going to."

sat_bug_1.speaker: Elysia
sat_bug_1.text: "K. I used to be the weird kid."

sat_bug_2.speaker: Elysia
sat_bug_2.text: "Slime girl. In third grade a boy scraped slime off a rotten log and smeared it inside my bag, and everyone laughed for a whole week. And I decided I'd never be weird again. Ever."

sat_bug_3.speaker: Elysia
sat_bug_3.text: "I watch everything I say. Every single thing. With my friends I'm doing a version. The fun one. The one who's always fine."

sat_bug_5.speaker: Elysia
sat_bug_5.text: "You and Mint are the only people I don't do the version with."

sat_why_1.speaker: Elysia
sat_why_1.text: "So when you won't walk with me because people will talk, it feels like you're agreeing with them. Like even you think I should be careful."

sat_why_2.speaker: Kay
sat_why_2.text: "I didn't— I thought I was protecting you."

sat_why_4.text: *She leans her head on his shoulder.*

sat_why_5.speaker: Elysia
sat_why_5.text: "I said I don't care what they think. I lied too. I care so much it makes me tired. But I care about you more."

choices.text: "You don't have to do the version with me. Ever."

sat_safe_1.text: *She cries a little and laughs at the same time.*

sat_safe_2.speaker: Elysia
sat_safe_2.text: "Okay. Then you don't have to be fine with me. Deal?"

mon_1.text: *Monday. Elysia is at the gate with her friends, same as always. She turns around like she felt him there, and waves.*

mon_2.text: *Kay looks at her friends. Then at her.*

mon_3.text: *He waves back. Faster than last time. Not as stiff.*

mon_walk_2.text: *Her friends go quiet and look at him. Then at her. Then at him again.*

mon_walk_3.speaker: Elysia
mon_walk_3.text: "Yes, he's my boyfriend, we all know, moving on."

mon_walk_4.text: *She takes his hand in front of all of them and doesn't let go.*

mon_walk_5.text: *Behind her, Mint gives Kay a very small thumbs up.*

guide_1.text: *Thursday. The guidance room is next to the home ec room. Someone has stuck paper flowers on the door, slightly crooked.*

guide_2.text: *Kay stands in front of it at lunch.*

guide_mom_2.speaker: Mom
guide_mom_2.text: thursday 🌱 proud of you whatever you decide

guide_ulyn_1.text: *Ulyn walked him here, and is still standing at the end of the hallway.*

guide_ulyn_2.speaker: Ulyn
guide_ulyn_2.text: "I'll be in the cafeteria. If you come out in thirty seconds, I'm sending you back in."

guide_in_2.speaker: Kay
guide_in_2.text: "...Do I have to explain why I'm here?"

guide_in_4.text: *So he sits. She makes tea. He doesn't say anything for ten minutes, and she doesn't fill the silence.*

guide_in_5.text: *It's the strangest ten minutes he's ever spent. Also the easiest.*

guide_in_10.text: *About Mom and the kitchen table. The slides. Being useful. The morning he couldn't get up. She doesn't try to fix any of it.*

guide_in_12.text: *He opens his mouth, and realizes nobody has ever asked him that. He doesn't know.*

guide_in_13.speaker: Ms. Noi
guide_in_13.text: "That's okay. That's what Thursdays are for."

guide_in_14.text: *Before he leaves, she says one more thing, very plainly.*

guide_in_15.speaker: Ms. Noi
guide_in_15.text: "If those heavy thoughts ever feel closer, not just tired but like you might hurt yourself, you tell me, or your mom, or you call the number on the poster by the door. Any day. You don't have to wait for Thursday."

guide_away_2.text: *He eats alone. The paper flowers stay in his head all afternoon.*

guide_away_ulyn_4.text: *Ulyn slides half his fried rice over.*

group_1.text: *Two weeks before the presentation, the group meets in the garden after school.*

group_2.text: *It looks like a garden now. The water spinach has gone wild. The marigolds are orange and loud around the edges.*

group_3.text: *Two chili plants survived and sulked their way into three small chilies. The new basil is coming up where the old basil died.*

group_4.text: *Fern sits on the edge of a bed with her laptop open.*

group_5.speaker: Fern
group_5.text: "Okay, so Kay, you'll put the presentation together like last time? You're the fastest."

group_split_1.speaker: Fern
group_split_1.text: "I mean, I know we said we'd split it. But you're just faster..."

group_ulyn_1.text: *Ulyn looks at Kay and doesn't say anything. He just waits.*

group_ulyn_2.text: *It's his way of saying: your turn.*

choices.text: "I can't do all of it this time. I need everyone to do their own part."

group_handle_2.text: *Kay does it again. All weekend, both days, until three in the morning.*

group_handle_3.text: *On Sunday, Ulyn comes over and sits on the floor doing the budget without being asked.*

group_handle_4.text: *He doesn't say anything about it. That's how Kay knows he noticed.*

group_speak_2.speaker: Bank
group_speak_2.text: "Oh. Wait. Did you... not want to? Before?"

group_speak_3.speaker: Kay
group_speak_3.text: "I offered because I didn't know how not to."

group_speak_5.speaker: Kay
group_speak_5.text: "You're not the worst. I just never said anything."

group_speak_6.speaker: Bank
group_speak_6.text: "Okay. Okay! I'll do the history part. I actually found stuff. The agriculture club had a photo album in the library, from like 2009."

group_bank_1.speaker: Bank
group_bank_1.text: "And I know how to start now. You showed me. The three bullet points thing."

group_split2_1.speaker: Fern
group_split2_1.text: "I'll do the slides. For real this time. I'm actually good at design. I just let you do it because you were faster, and it was easier."

group_split2_2.speaker: Ulyn
group_split2_2.text: "And I'll do the budget. And stop sleeping in class. Maybe."

group_split2_3.text: *That night, for the first time all semester, there are four different cursors in the shared document at once.*

water_1.text: *Before he leaves, Kay pushes his finger into the soil of the basil bed. Still damp from yesterday.*

water_2.text: *His hand goes to the tap on its own.*

water_5.text: *It's harder than it should be, walking away from a damp bed without doing anything to it.*

water_6.text: *The next morning, the basil is fine.*

pres2_2.text: *Group 3 is up first again. Kay, Ulyn, Bank, and Fern at the front of the room. The gaps between them are smaller this time.*

pres2_3.speaker: Kay
pres2_3.text: "Good morning. We're group 3. This semester, we brought the school garden back to life."

pres2_4.speaker: Ulyn
pres2_4.text: "Ulyn. I did the budget, so if it looks cheap, that's on purpose."

pres2_5.text: *People laugh. Fern clicks to the next slide: an old photo of students in rain boots, standing in the same four beds.*

pres2_6.speaker: Bank
pres2_6.text: "So, the garden was first built in... in, uh..."

pres2_7.text: *Silence. Somebody's chair squeaks. The teacher's pen stops moving.*

pres2_8.speaker: Kay
pres2_8.text: It's the same. It's exactly the same.

choices.text: Step in and cover for him

pres2_cover_3.text: *Bank keeps going. It goes fine. Everything goes fine.*

pres2_knew_1.text: *As Fern clicks to the next slide, Bank whispers out of the corner of his mouth.*

pres2_knew_2.speaker: Bank
pres2_knew_2.text: "I knew it, I swear. I just panicked."

pres2_knew_3.text: *Kay realizes he didn't need to step in. Bank would have found it.*

pres2_wait_2.text: *Bank looks at him, panicking. Kay nods. Very small.*

pres2_wait_4.text: *Bank doesn't find it. He never read the report. Kay wrote it.*

pres2_wait_5.speaker: Fern
pres2_wait_5.text: "It's— um. It's on the next slide, actually."

pres2_wait_8.text: *It's messy, and Kay finishes the section himself. But for five seconds, he wasn't the only one holding it.*

pres2_found_1.text: *Bank looks back at the slide. At the old photo.*

pres2_found_2.speaker: Bank
pres2_found_2.text: "Two thousand nine! The agriculture club. My uncle was actually in it. That's him, in the yellow boots. That's how I found the album."

pres2_found_3.text: *Somebody in the back says "whoa." Bank grins and keeps going, and gets better with every sentence.*

pres2_end_1.speaker: Teacher
pres2_end_1.text: "Very well done, group 3. Good teamwork, everyone."

pres2_end_2.text: *The same words as last time. Word for word.*

noi_end_1.text: *That afternoon, Ms. Noi comes out to the garden with their grades and a piece of news.*

noi_end_2.speaker: Ms. Noi
noi_end_2.text: "The school wants to keep the garden. The agriculture club is coming back next semester."

noi_end_4.text: *She looks pointedly at Bank and Fern.*

noi_end_6.speaker: Bank
noi_end_6.text: "My uncle cried when I showed him the photos."

endA_2.text: *Kay turns off the alarm. This time, he opens his eyes.*

endA_5.text: *Still cold. He laughs at it, which is new.*

endA_hot_1.text: *Hot water. He stands under it an extra minute, just because he can.*

endA_fridge_1.text: *The fridge is full. Eggs, milk, green things in a bag.*

endA_fridge_2.text: *On the door, a sticky note: "Eat something real today! (There's real stuff now.) - Mom"*

endA_note_1.text: *Under it, a second note: "Day off Saturday. Let's go somewhere. Your pick."*

endA_gate_1.text: *At the gate, Elysia is with her friends. She turns around like she felt him there.*

endA_beetle_1.text: *She holds up her phone in front of everyone: a slime mold, huge and yellow and foamy, spread across a drain cover.*

endA_beetle_3.text: *One of her friends makes a face. Elysia doesn't look over her shoulder. She doesn't even check.*

endA_ask_3.speaker: Ulyn
endA_ask_3.text: "...My mom wants me to come home more. I'm trying."

endA_ask_5.speaker: Kay
endA_ask_5.text: "Want company? I can come over and be boring at your house."

endA_ask_6.text: *Ulyn looks at him for a long second.*

endA_thursdays_1.text: *On Thursdays he still goes to the room with the paper flowers. Some weeks he talks a lot. Some weeks he just drinks the tea. Ms. Noi says both count.*

endA_garden_1.text: *After the last bell, Kay goes to the garden one more time before the break. He pushes his finger into the soil.*

endA_garden_3.text: *He waters it. Not twice. Not three times. Just enough.*

endA_garden_4.text: *Then he turns off the screaming tap, and leaves it alone.*

endA_garden_5.text: *That night, he lies in bed and looks at the ceiling.*

endA_garden_7.text: *He thinks about it honestly, the way he's been practicing.*

endA_garden_8.speaker: Kay
endA_garden_8.text: Not fine. Good. Today was good.

endA_garden_9.speaker: Kay
endA_garden_9.text: It won't always be good. Some mornings will still be heavy. Some mornings the floor will still be far away.

endA_garden_10.speaker: Kay
endA_garden_10.text: If I stayed home, would anyone notice?

endA_garden_11.speaker: Kay
endA_garden_11.text: ...Yeah. They would. They'd come over and bring pork.

endA_garden_12.text: *He falls asleep before the ceiling gets dark.*

endB_1.text: *Kay turns off the alarm and lies there a minute. Then he gets up.*

endB_2.text: *It's easier than some mornings. Harder than others.*

endB_3.text: *At the gate, Elysia waves. He waves back and smiles. Not the practiced smile. Not entirely.*

endB_4.text: *Ulyn catches up with him at the stairs.*

endB_9.speaker: Ulyn
endB_9.text: "My treat? Since when is it my treat?"

endB_11.text: *Ulyn laughs, surprised. Kay realizes that was him asking for something. A small something. It still counts.*

endB_12.text: *After school, Kay waters the garden one last time before the break. He's halfway through a second pass before he catches himself, and turns off the tap.*

endB_16.text: *He waits to see if that's true.*

endB_20.text: *Kay types "yeah." Looks at it. Deletes it.*

endB_22.text: *He sends it before he can change his mind.*

endC_1.text: *Kay turns off the alarm without opening his eyes.*

endC_2.text: *He gets up. He always gets up. The one morning he didn't feels like it happened to somebody else.*

endC_3.text: *At school, everything goes well. Group 3 gets the top grade. The teacher says "as always." Bank and Fern hug him at the same time.*

endC_8.text: *He reads it. It's like reading somebody else's message.*

endC_9.text: *After the last bell, he goes to the garden alone and waters every bed. Then again.*

endC_10.text: *The soil goes dark and shiny. Water pools around the stems of the basil. He keeps the hose on anyway.*

endC_11.speaker: Kay
endC_11.text: It's easier than standing here with nothing to do.

endC_12.text: *That night, Kay lies in bed and looks at the ceiling.*

endC_told_1.speaker: Ulyn
endC_told_1.text: you told me once. you can tell me again.

endC_msg_2.text: *Kay types "yeah all good!" His thumb hovers over send.*

endC_msg_6.text: *The message sits there. The cursor blinks. It's still his to send.*
